executive_summary.summary:
Disney+ demonstrated strong performance on LG Ads during FY24 H2 (April-September 2024), investing $1.8M in acquisition campaigns that delivered 40K new users at a highly efficient $45.44 CPA—representing a 22% improvement versus H1. The standout innovation was the Content Store Roadblock, which despite representing only 8% of budget, drove 16% of new user acquisitions at a $25.50 CPA, 71% more efficient than traditional roadblocks. The partnership expanded significantly with Disney+ active 51% of H2 through 8 home screen takeovers and added value support totaling $113K.

However, competitive analysis reveals concerning trends. Disney+ ranks #8 among M&E partners with an 88 index versus top competitors, allowing rivals to achieve greater share of voice. The platform's MAU growth on LG TVs significantly lags the overall LG universe growth, with Disney+ reaching only 4.5M (24%) of the addressable audience monthly. With 78% of LG users having the app installed but 63% classified as lapsed, there's substantial opportunity to improve retention and re-engagement through more consistent rotational presence beyond premiere-focused roadblocks.
key_wins: Achieved $45.44 CPA for new user acquisition, 22% more efficient than H1 ($58.52)
Content Store Roadblock delivered exceptional performance: $25.50 CPA with 19% install-to-acquisition ratio and 0.54% install rate
First-time Lapsed audience targeting achieved efficient $4.82 CPE, re-engaging 46.6K users
Secured FY25 XLOB Partnership approval at $17M, demonstrating strong commitment
Exposed audience showed +26% increase in average viewing time (94 mins vs 74 mins)
areas_for_improvement: Competitive positioning: Disney+ ranks #8 with 88 index versus top 20 M&E accounts, allowing competitors greater share of voice
Platform growth disparity: Disney+ MAU growth significantly lags LG universe expansion
High lapsed user rate: 63% of installed base classified as lapsed (not used in 60 days)
Limited sustained presence: Only reaching 24% (4.5M) of LG universe monthly on average, primarily through roadblocks rather than consistent rotational campaigns
recommendations: Increase investment in rotational ROS campaigns targeting Not Installed (22% of universe) and Lapsed (63% of installed base) audiences to improve sustained presence and retention
Expand Content Store Roadblock usage given its 71% CPA efficiency advantage and strong performance metrics
Shift creative strategy: reduce static carousel usage (68% of H2, lowest performing) in favor of companion video and 3D animation formats that drive 2-3x better engagement
Implement more consistent always-on presence to close the competitive gap and improve MAU growth trajectory on LG platform
Leverage new product innovations including InLine Banner, CTV Video Branded Player, and video-enabled Content Store to diversify media mix
next_steps: Finalize ADID integration with Kochava for deterministic matching and enhanced measurement capabilities
Launch automated daily delivery reporting to AWS S3 bucket to improve data accessibility
Execute Content Store Roadblock tests in Germany and Italy markets (Q2 FY25)
Implement targeting innovation testing for Native ROS to optimize audience strategies
Schedule EMEA Creative Summit to scale successful US creative approaches globally
key_metrics_highlighted: 94 minutes average viewing duration for exposed audience (+26% vs baseline)
